name: VAS Variance Report - Rules, Framework and File Requirements
purpose: Reconcile the same business events as recorded by independent systems, quantify every disagreement, and classify its root cause. The Variance Report does NOT produce KPIs - it proves whether the KPIs in the MTD report can be trusted.

scope_note.two_artefacts_share_this_name: Clarify which is meant before building.

A_daily_variance_report.description: The existing operational file 'Variance Report DD.MM.YYYY.xlsx', one per day, discovered as an external link inside the MTD tracker.
A_daily_variance_report.confirmed_location: SharePoint > Sales Optimization > Variance Report > {Month YYYY} > {DD.MM.YYYY} > Variance Report DD.MM.YYYY.xlsx
A_daily_variance_report.inferred_purpose: Per-agent, per-day reconciliation of Salesforce against the agent-logged Daily Tracker and against dialler activity. The 'variance' is the gap between what the system recorded and what the agent claimed.
A_daily_variance_report.status: NOT SUPPLIED. Structure known only from cached external-link values inside the MTD tracker.

B_engine_variance_report.description: The reconciliation of the rebuilt MTD engine output against the reference MTD tracker, proving each rule reproduces the original.
B_engine_variance_report.status: BUILT AND VERIFIED. This JSON specifies it in full.
B_engine_variance_report.note: Both are covered below: section 'daily_system_variance' specifies A, section 'engine_reconciliation' specifies B. They share the file list, identity layer and root-cause taxonomy.

snapshot_discipline.principle: A variance report is only meaningful if every source was captured at the same instant. Comparing a 05 Aug export against a 04 Aug build measures elapsed time, not disagreement.
rules: Record the export timestamp of every source file in the output header.
Assert all sources were captured within the same business day; if not, downgrade every variance to 'indeterminate - snapshot skew' and say so.
Archive the source files used for each run. A live re-pull will not reproduce the report.
Where a source carries an internal timestamp (Vici line 2 'Time range', QA 'Submitted At'), assert it against the intended window rather than trusting the filename.
snapshot_discipline.observed_impact: In the reference period the BI exports were dated 05 Aug and the tracker was built 04 Aug. This alone accounted for 2 sales, 3 GWP and 3 cancellation differences, plus almost every QA difference.

identity_layer.principle: Employee Code is canonical. Every variance is agent-level, so an identity failure manufactures a false variance on BOTH sides - one agent shows a shortfall, a phantom agent shows a surplus.
resolution_order: name vs roster 'Sales Force' then 'Agent Name'
identity_layer.dialler_label_rule: Match on the NAME portion, never the embedded CB number. Four roster labels carry numbers that contradict their own Employee Code column; CB-138 is claimed by two people and matching on the number misassigns 735 calls.

superseded_qa_codes._scope: QA rows only - CB207 is also Renolan Pillay's Vici ID

known_corrections.owner_suffix: Strip ' - Panimax' from the BI Owner field before matching.

identity_layer.rule: Resolve identity BEFORE computing any variance. An unresolved agent is an identity defect, not a data variance, and must be reported separately so it is not read as a performance gap.

comparison_procedure: 1. Rebuild the fact table from source using the MTD engine rules.
2. Extract the reference values from the baseline workbook's MTD sheets and fact table.
3. Join on resolved Employee Code - never on display name, which drifts between systems.
4. Compute variance = engine - reference for every metric at its stated grain.
5. Classify each non-zero variance using root_cause_taxonomy.
6. Assert the residual set matches the expected profile; investigate anything outside it.
7. NEVER adjust a rule to close a variance until the root cause is established.

anti_pattern.rule: Do not tune a calculation to hit the reference number.
anti_pattern.worked_example: Two agents were 1 sale short. Every alternative grain was tested - distinct Case, Account+CaseType, Account+Date all returned the same figure; distinct Contract and raw rows jumped from 20 to 51. No grain produces the reference value, and 63 agents already reconcile exactly. A rule fitting 63 agents exactly and missing 2 by one is a correct rule meeting incomplete data. Changing the grain would have broken 63 to fix 2.

root_cause_taxonomy.principle: Every variance must be classified. An unclassified variance is an open defect, not a result.

classes.name: Snapshot drift
classes.definition: Sources captured at different times. The event exists in one snapshot and not the other.
classes.signature: Small magnitude, differences run in BOTH directions, correlates with export timestamps.
classes.test: Compare source export timestamps against the build time. For QA, group by 'Submitted At' date.
classes.resolution: Align export cut-offs. Never adjust the rule.
classes.observed: 2 sales, 3 GWP, 3 cancellations, and most Cuddle QA figures in the reference period.

classes.name: Wrong source system
classes.definition: The engine reads a different system to the one the reference used.
classes.signature: Systematic one-directional bias, consistent ratio across agents, uncorrelated with volume.
classes.test: Compute the engine/reference ratio per row. A stable ratio away from 1.0 indicates a source mismatch, not rounding.
classes.resolution: Obtain the correct source. Do not apply a correction factor - it masks the defect.
classes.observed: Courtesy talk time: median ratio 1.0478, correlation with call volume 0.055, no billing-increment rounding present. Cuddle from Vici sits at 0.9887, confirming the reference is dialler-side.

classes.name: Identity break
classes.definition: An agent resolved to the wrong code, or to none.
classes.signature: One agent shows a total shortfall while another shows an unexplained surplus, or an agent shows zero on a metric where other systems show activity.
classes.test: Cross-check the agent across all systems. Zero in one with activity in others is the marker.
classes.resolution: Correct the mapping and rerun. Fix the roster at source.
classes.observed: Lindokuhle Phakathi (CB263) showed reference talk time of 0 on both days because the reference VLOOKUP used the roster's stale label 'Nomonde Ntoza CB-263'. He had dialled 646 calls.

classes.name: Manual override
classes.definition: A human edited the reference away from what the data supports.
classes.signature: Isolated, no pattern, contradicts every available source.
classes.test: Confirm all candidate rules fail on that row while succeeding elsewhere.
classes.resolution: Confirm intent with the report owner. Document; do not encode as a rule.
classes.observed: Mzwandile Masuku - HR Present, dialled 5,125s, reference records 0 shifts. Surprise Lucky Cwele - HR Uncomm Absence, dialled 4,428s, reference records 0.5.

classes.name: Scope mismatch
classes.definition: The two sides cover different populations.
classes.signature: Agents present on one side only.
classes.test: Set-difference the agent lists before comparing values.
classes.resolution: Agree the scope explicitly and state it in the output header.
classes.observed: The reference QA pivot includes 7 Vehicle Tracking agents absent from the VAS roster - it averages the whole business, not VAS. Separately, the Nesting campaign (3 agents, 17 sales) is filtered out of both reference pivots and appears nowhere.

classes.name: Calculation defect
classes.definition: A genuine rule or formula error on either side.
classes.signature: Reproducible, directional, survives every other explanation.
classes.test: Only assign after RC1-RC5 are excluded.
classes.resolution: Fix the rule and record which side was wrong.
classes.observed: Reference cell TL MTD!E38 reads '=SUM(F13:I13)' - it sums the Courtesy block instead of the Cuddle cancellation cells C38:D38.

classes.name: Missing source
classes.definition: A required input was not supplied.
classes.signature: The metric cannot be computed at all.
classes.resolution: Emit null, never zero. Report as blocked.
classes.observed: Referrals - VAS Daily Tracker not supplied.

tolerance_framework.principle: State the tolerance before running the comparison. A tolerance chosen after seeing the result is a rationalisation.

bands.action: FAIL - classify and report; do not adjust the rule

tolerance_framework.rule: Percentages are compared on their underlying numerator and denominator, never on rounded display values.

sheets.name: Summary
sheets.content: Period, source export timestamps, snapshot-skew assertion, per-metric pass/fail with counts, root-cause classification for every residual, and the actions required.
sheets.rule: Must be readable without opening any other sheet.

sheets.name: KPI Variance
sheets.content: Per agent: reference value, engine value, difference, root-cause code, verdict.
sheets.conditional_format: green exact, amber within tolerance, red material

sheets.name: Talk Time Variance
sheets.content: Per agent per day: source system, call count, reference, engine, difference in seconds, ratio.

sheets.name: QA Variance
sheets.content: Per agent: evaluation count, reference QA, engine QA, difference in percentage points, status.
sheets.extra: Include a Submitted At distribution to evidence RC1 timing.

sheets.name: QA Evaluations
sheets.content: Every evaluation in the period with all workflow fields. Critical Fail shaded red, Coaching amber.

sheets.name: Attendance Variance
sheets.content: Per agent per day: reference shift, HR status, HR-rule result, dialler-rule result, talk time, verdict naming which rule is correct.

sheets.name: Unmapped
sheets.content: Every record that failed identity resolution, with its source, raw label and record count.
sheets.rule: Must exist even when empty, so an empty result is visibly a result rather than an omission.

sheets.name: Source Extracts
sheets.content: Raw extract of each source as pulled, so every variance is traceable without re-querying.

output_structure.post_build: Recalculate and re-save the workbook so every formula carries a cached value. Formulas written programmatically render BLANK in previewers and on mobile until recalculated.

dialler_coverage.note: VR16 — the always-pulls law (owner directive 2026-08-17). Each reported campaign names its DAY-LEVEL dialler source; a campaign with day-level rows on fewer than min_day_share of the compared days FAILS VR16 (error), naming the export and user groups to pull. Any-single-day is NOT coverage: the live August state held one Cuddle login with 0.0h on the 3rd and nothing else — that must fail. Period-aggregated exports are estimates, never DV03 evidence.

Courtesy.remedy: Pull EXPORT_CALL_REPORT with EVERY user group ticked (Courtesy and Nesting groups included — an unticked group reads as agents who never dialled) and drop it on the ViciDial slot. Days before 2026-09-01 may still be evidenced by the CallX call_records export.

Cuddle.remedy: Pull EXPORT_CALL_REPORT with the Cuddle floor user groups ticked (or all user groups). For past days, a SINGLE-DAY Vici - Cuddle Agents (Agent Performance Detail) export per day also counts as day-level. A multi-day aggregate is an estimate, never DV03 evidence.

dialler_coverage.no_pull_marker: A reported-campaign agent-day with talk unknown and unestimated renders "no pull" in the Vicci columns (with the remedy as tooltip) — never a bare dash or a zero.

sale_unit.note: One sale is one CASE. A case bundles its charge lines (MYP C35 30.43 + FST R39 33.91 + HMDC25 21.74 = 86.08 -> R99). An ACCOUNT is the customer and can hold several cases, so account grain merged two same-day sales by one agent into a single double-value sale. Verified: no case spans two accounts (0 of 4164), and the regrain moves GWP by R0.
sale_unit.uncased_rows: Pooled into one residual per agent-day, keyed ~uncased: carries GWP, never counted as a sale.
sale_unit.net_note: SWITCH: MTD_RULES.salesNetOfCancellation. SET TRUE 2026-08-18 on the owner directive — sales count only what is still active. This is the setting that makes Enoch Pillay August MTD read 127 rather than 130, and floor-wide 3131 -> 3071 sales / R313662 -> R306900 across 33 of 79 agents. The reference workbook counts GROSS and is therefore knowingly superseded: verify-mtd-values PINS the resulting per-agent divergence (7 agents) so it cannot drift unnoticed.
sale_unit.gwp_display_basis_note: MTD pages display GWP ex-VAT (agent comms basis) since 2026-08-18. DV02 in THIS module stays VAT-inclusive by spec — the board it compares against logs inclusive values (a R99 sale is written 99). Deliberate, documented, never mixed in one comparison.
